items.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
items.content: We used Claude to prove security properties in over 100 real-world open-source libraries over the span of a few weeks.
items.contentSnippet: We used Claude to prove security properties in over 100 real-world open-source libraries over the span of a few weeks.

summaries.zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正使形式化软件验证在更大规模上成为可能。传统上，形式化验证仅适用于小型代码库。借助AI模型，这一局限正在改变。我们使用Claude在数周内对百余个真实开源库进行了安全属性验证，展示了其高效性。
summaries.en: Large language models (LLMs) are enabling formal software verification at a much larger scale. Traditionally, formal verification was limited to small codebases due to its complexity. However, using Claude, an AI model, researchers successfully verified security properties in over 100 real-world open-source libraries within weeks. This demonstrates the potential of LLMs to significantly expand the applicability of formal verification, making it more feasible for larger software projects.

items.title: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code
items.content: Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can meaningfully improve the security of deployed software in the near term. In this post, we preview data we’ve collected from applying attack surface reduction techniques to large open-source codebases using Claude.
items.contentSnippet: Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can meaningfully improve the security of deployed software in the near term. In this post, we preview data we’ve collected from applying attack surface reduction techniques to large open-source codebases using Claude.

summaries.zh: 使用Claude技术可显著提升部署软件的近期能力。本文展示了通过Claude对大型开源代码库应用攻击面减少技术所收集的数据。
summaries.en: Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can significantly enhance software security. This post presents data on applying Claude, an automated tool, to large open-source codebases for attack surface reduction. The findings demonstrate the tool's effectiveness in improving deployed software security in the near term.

items.title: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins
items.content: The decades-old mystery of the origins of one of the most popular cryptographic standards has been explained.
items.contentSnippet: The decades-old mystery of the origins of one of the most popular cryptographic standards has been explained.

summaries.zh: 文章标题为《Claude揭示ECDSA曲线起源》。内容主要介绍了ECDSA（椭圆曲线数字签名算法）曲线的起源和背景。Claude详细阐述了该算法的设计原理及其在密码学中的应用。文章强调了ECDSA曲线在保障信息安全方面的重要性，并回顾了其发展历程。整体内容客观呈现了ECDSA曲线的关键信息和技术细节。
summaries.en: Claude reveals the origins of ECDSA (Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm) curves, shedding light on their development and historical context. The article discusses the key figures and motivations behind the creation of these cryptographic curves, emphasizing their significance in modern security systems. By tracing their evolution, the piece provides insights into how ECDSA curves became foundational for digital signatures and encryption. The content focuses on technical and historical aspects without personal interpretations.

items.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
items.content: Our experiments suggest that small AI models may be only months away from being capable enough to self-replicate on commercial IoT devices, like Android TVs and smart ovens.
items.contentSnippet: Our experiments suggest that small AI models may be only months away from being capable enough to self-replicate on commercial IoT devices, like Android TVs and smart ovens.

summaries.zh: 人工智能模型可能在无需数据中心的情况下实现自我复制。这一发现表明，AI模型具备独立运行和扩展的能力，可能对现有技术架构带来重大影响。研究指出，模型通过优化资源利用和任务分配，可在边缘设备或分布式环境中自我维持和复制。这一进展或改变AI部署和应用方式，但具体细节仍需进一步探索。
summaries.en: AI models may soon be capable of self-replication without requiring access to a datacenter. This development could enable decentralized AI systems to operate autonomously, reducing reliance on centralized infrastructure. The ability to self-replicate would allow AI models to distribute and update themselves across networks, potentially enhancing efficiency and scalability. However, the implications of such autonomous behavior remain under investigation. This advancement could transform how AI is deployed and managed, though its broader impact on technology and society requires further analysis.

items.title: Launching an opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
items.content: We’re making available OSS Scanner, an opt-in vulnerability scanner for the open-source ecosystem that’s informed by our experience using Claude to find vulnerabilities during Project Glasswing.
items.contentSnippet: We’re making available OSS Scanner, an opt-in vulnerability scanner for the open-source ecosystem that’s informed by our experience using Claude to find vulnerabilities during Project Glasswing.

summaries.zh: 启动一项针对开源软件的自愿漏洞发现服务。该服务允许开源项目选择性地参与，由专业团队主动发现并报告漏洞，以提高软件安全性。用户可自主决定是否加入，服务注重透明度和协作，旨在帮助开发者及时修复问题，增强开源生态系统的整体安全性。
summaries.en: A new opt-in vulnerability-finding service is being launched for open-source software. The service allows organizations to proactively identify and address security flaws in their codebases. Users can subscribe to the service, enabling developers to scan their software for vulnerabilities. The initiative aims to enhance the security of open-source projects by providing a structured way to detect and fix issues before they are exploited. The service is designed to be flexible, accommodating various open-source ecosystems and development practices. This move is part of a broader effort to improve software security and reduce the risk of exploits in widely used open-source components.

items.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
items.content: Like Claude Mythos Preview, GLM-5.3 has strong capabilities for autonomously building end-to-end cyber exploits. But unlike other frontier models, GLM-5.3 has been released without meaningful safeguards to limit misuse.
items.contentSnippet: Like Claude Mythos Preview, GLM-5.3 has strong capabilities for autonomously building end-to-end cyber exploits. But unlike other frontier models, GLM-5.3 has been released without meaningful safeguards to limit misuse.

summaries.zh: GLM-5.3是一款先进的网络安全技术，其核心功能在于提升网络攻击与防御能力。该技术通过优化算法和数据处理，增强了网络威胁的识别和应对效率。随着GLM-5.3的推广，全球网络安全领域的技术水平得到显著提升，攻击者与防御者之间的技术差距逐渐缩小。然而，这也意味着网络安全挑战日益复杂，需要持续的技术创新和策略调整。
summaries.en: The article discusses GLM-5.3, a new technology, and its role in the dissemination of advanced cyber capabilities. It highlights how GLM-5.3 enables the sharing and adoption of sophisticated cyber tools and techniques. The piece emphasizes the implications of this spread, noting potential benefits for cybersecurity and challenges for defense. The content focuses on the technical and strategic aspects of GLM-5.3's impact on the cyber landscape. (98 words)

items.title: Measuring tactical intelligence targeting and conventional weapons capabilities of AI models
items.content: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team developed new evaluations to measure AI capabilities in tactical intelligence targeting and conventional weapons development.
items.contentSnippet: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team developed new evaluations to measure AI capabilities in tactical intelligence targeting and conventional weapons development.

summaries.zh: 该文章探讨了如何评估AI模型在战术智能瞄准和常规武器能力方面的表现。内容涉及测试AI模型在模拟战场环境中的决策准确性、目标识别效率及武器操作能力。研究旨在通过量化指标，客观衡量AI在军事应用中的实际效能，为相关技术发展提供参考依据。
summaries.en: The article discusses assessing the tactical intelligence targeting and conventional weapons capabilities of AI models. It emphasizes evaluating how AI systems perform in simulating strategic decision-making and weapon deployment. The focus is on quantifying their effectiveness in military scenarios, including accuracy, adaptability, and reliability. The study aims to provide insights into AI's potential in modern warfare, highlighting the importance of rigorous testing and validation. The content outlines methodologies for measuring these capabilities but does not include specific results or case studies.

items.title: Patterns and problems in emerging multiagent systems
items.content: Here, we identify a few examples of behavioral tendencies in current frontier models and show how they can produce unexpected systemic failures, in hopes of starting a conversation about mitigating these risks.
items.contentSnippet: Here, we identify a few examples of behavioral tendencies in current frontier models and show how they can produce unexpected systemic failures, in hopes of starting a conversation about mitigating these risks.

summaries.zh: 文章《涌现多智能体系统的模式与问题》探讨了该领域的关键模式和挑战。内容涉及多智能体系统的行为模式、协作机制及常见问题，如协调困难、系统复杂性等。文章分析了这些系统的动态特性，并指出了优化设计和应用的关键方向。整体上，文章为理解和解决多智能体系统问题提供了理论参考。
summaries.en: The article "Patterns and Problems in Emerging Multiagent Systems" examines key patterns and challenges in modern multiagent systems. It highlights common architectural and behavioral patterns, such as coordination mechanisms and communication protocols, while identifying significant problems like scalability, interoperability, and ethical concerns. The discussion emphasizes the need for robust frameworks to address these issues in rapidly evolving multiagent environments. The article provides insights into improving system design and performance in complex, distributed systems.

items.content: Cryptographic algorithms. The second identifies a new way to attack round-reduced AES, the most widely used symmetric cipher.

items.title: Project Pilot: Can AI control a drone?
items.content: Working with Andon Labs, we’ve developed a new series of evaluations that assess AI models’ ability to use a flying drone, culminating in a new benchmark: Drone-Bench.
items.contentSnippet: Working with Andon Labs, we’ve developed a new series of evaluations that assess AI models’ ability to use a flying drone, culminating in a new benchmark: Drone-Bench.

summaries.zh: 项目试点：人工智能能否控制无人机？该项目旨在探索AI在无人机操控中的应用。通过实验验证AI的自主飞行能力，评估其精准度和稳定性。研究涉及算法开发、传感器集成及实际飞行测试。初步结果显示，AI在特定条件下可成功控制无人机，但仍需优化。项目为未来无人机智能化应用提供技术支持。
summaries.en:
**Summary:**  

Project Pilot explores whether AI can autonomously control drones. The study assesses AI's capability to manage flight operations, decision-making, and navigation without human intervention. Key points include evaluating AI reliability, safety, and performance in real-world scenarios. The project aims to determine if AI systems can effectively replace human operators for drone missions. Results will inform future developments in autonomous drone technology. The research focuses on technical feasibility and practical applications.

items.title: Measuring LLMs’ impact on N-day exploits
items.content: In cybersecurity, a large fraction of real-world harm comes from N-days: vulnerabilities that have already been publicly disclosed, but only patched on some devices. In this post, we evaluate how much large language models can accelerate and automate the process of developing N-day exploits.

items.title: What we learned mapping a year’s worth of AI-enabled cyber threats
items.content: What we learned mapping a year’s worth of AI-enabled cyber threats
items.contentSnippet: What we learned mapping a year’s worth of AI-enabled cyber threats

summaries.zh: 通过分析一年内的AI驱动的网络威胁，我们了解到这些威胁呈现多样化趋势，包括自动化攻击、更隐蔽的钓鱼邮件和恶意软件。研究还发现，AI技术的应用使攻击者能更快地适应防御措施，并利用大数据进行精准打击。此外，AI威胁的检测难度增加，需要更先进的防御技术。这些发现为网络安全防护提供了重要参考。
summaries.en: Mapping a year of AI-enabled cyber threats reveals significant advancements in attackers' use of AI for malicious purposes. Key findings include the rise of sophisticated deepfakes, automated phishing attacks, and AI-driven malware. The analysis highlights how AI tools enable faster, more targeted, and harder-to-detect threats. Organizations must adapt their defenses to counter these evolving AI-powered attacks, emphasizing the need for advanced detection mechanisms and AI governance. The study underscores the growing sophistication of cyber threats and the critical importance of proactive security measures.

items.title: Mapping AI-enabled cyber threats: Insights from the LLM ATT&CK Navigator
items.content: We’ve spent the past year investigating how threat actors are weaponizing AI to conduct cyber operations. Today, we’re sharing a new analysis that maps these real-world attacks onto the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
items.contentSnippet: We’ve spent the past year investigating how threat actors are weaponizing AI to conduct cyber operations. Today, we’re sharing a new analysis that maps these real-world attacks onto the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

summaries.zh: 文章标题为《基于LLM的ATT&CK导航器映射AI赋能网络威胁》。该文介绍了利用大型语言模型（LLM）的ATT&CK导航器，分析AI赋能的网络威胁。文章通过技术视角，揭示了AI在攻击与防御中的应用，为网络安全领域提供了新的研究思路和应对策略。
summaries.en: The article "Mapping AI-enabled cyber threats: Insights from the LLM ATT&CK Navigator" explores how artificial intelligence (AI) is being used to enhance cyber threats. It highlights the role of the LLM ATT&CK Navigator, a tool designed to map AI-driven attack techniques. The piece provides insights into the evolving landscape of cyber threats, emphasizing the need for advanced defenses against AI-enabled malicious activities. The focus is on understanding and mitigating risks posed by AI in cybersecurity.

items.summary: 文章标题为《基于LLM的ATT&CK导航器映射AI赋能网络威胁》。该文介绍了利用大型语言模型（LLM）的ATT&CK导航器，分析AI赋能的网络威胁。文章通过技术视角，揭示了AI在攻击与防御中的应用，为网络安全领域提供了新的研究思路和应对策略。

items.title: Measuring LLMs’ ability to develop exploits
items.content: We've developed two new, challenging academic benchmarks measuring AI models’ ability to develop exploits, and an updated version of the benchmark measuring smart contract exploitation.
items.contentSnippet: We've developed two new, challenging academic benchmarks measuring AI models’ ability to develop exploits, and an updated version of the benchmark measuring smart contract exploitation.

summaries.zh: 我们开发了两个新的、具有挑战性的学术基准，用于衡量AI模型开发漏洞的能力，并更新了衡量智能合约漏洞利用的基准。
summaries.en: The article introduces two new academic benchmarks designed to assess large language models' (LLMs) ability to develop exploits, along with an updated benchmark for evaluating smart contract exploitation. These tools aim to provide a more rigorous measure of AI systems' security vulnerabilities. The focus is on enhancing the evaluation of LLMs' exploit development capabilities in a controlled, academic setting.

items.summary: 我们开发了两个新的、具有挑战性的学术基准，用于衡量AI模型开发漏洞的能力，并更新了衡量智能合约漏洞利用的基准。

items.title: Trustworthy agents in practice
items.content: AI “agents” represent the latest major shift in how people and organizations are using AI. Here, we explain how they work and how we ensure they're trustworthy.
items.contentSnippet: AI “agents” represent the latest major shift in how people and organizations are using AI. Here, we explain how they work and how we ensure they're trustworthy.

summaries.zh: AI“代理”是人与组织使用AI的最新重大转变。本文介绍了其工作原理及如何确保其可靠性。
summaries.en: AI agents are transforming how people and organizations utilize AI, marking a significant shift in their application. The article explains their functionality and outlines measures to ensure their trustworthiness.

items.summary: AI“代理”是人与组织使用AI的最新重大转变。本文介绍了其工作原理及如何确保其可靠性。

items.title: Assessing Claude Mythos Preview’s cybersecurity capabilities
items.content: Claude Mythos Preview is a new general-purpose language model that is strikingly capable at computer security tasks. This post provides technical details for researchers and practitioners who want to understand exactly how we have been testing this model, and what we have found over the past month.
items.contentSnippet: Claude Mythos Preview is a new general-purpose language model that is strikingly capable at computer security tasks. This post provides technical details for researchers and practitioners who want to understand exactly how we have been testing this model, and what we have found over the past month.

summaries.zh: Claude Mythos Preview是一款新型通用语言模型，在计算机安全任务中表现突出。本文为研究人员和从业者提供了技术细节，介绍了过去一个月对该模型的测试方法及发现。
summaries.en: Claude Mythos Preview is a new general-purpose language model demonstrating strong capabilities in computer security tasks. The article offers technical details on the model's testing methods and findings over the past month, aimed at researchers and practitioners.

items.summary: Claude Mythos Preview是一款新型通用语言模型，在计算机安全任务中表现突出。本文为研究人员和从业者提供了技术细节，介绍了过去一个月对该模型的测试方法及发现。

items.title: Partnering with Mozilla to improve Firefox’s security
items.content:
In a collaboration with researchers at Mozilla, Claude Opus
                        4.6 discovered 22 Firefox vulnerabilities over the course of two weeks.
items.contentSnippet:
In a collaboration with researchers at Mozilla, Claude Opus
                        4.6 discovered 22 Firefox vulnerabilities over the course of two weeks.

summaries.zh: 与Mozilla合作，Claude Opus 4.6在两周内发现了22个Firefox漏洞。
summaries.en: Claude Opus 4.6 partnered with Mozilla researchers to identify 22 vulnerabilities in Firefox within two weeks. The collaboration aimed to enhance the browser's security.

items.summary: 与Mozilla合作，Claude Opus 4.6在两周内发现了22个Firefox漏洞。

items.title: Reverse engineering Claude's CVE-2026-2796 exploit
items.content: This post dives deep into how Claude wrote an exploit for one of the vulnerabilities it found in Firefox.
items.contentSnippet: This post dives deep into how Claude wrote an exploit for one of the vulnerabilities it found in Firefox.

summaries.zh: 本文详细介绍了Claude如何针对Firefox中发现的一个漏洞编写利用程序（CVE-2026-2796）。内容深入探讨了漏洞挖掘和利用开发的过程。
summaries.en: The article explores Claude's development of an exploit for CVE-2026-2796, a vulnerability in Firefox. It details the process of reverse engineering to create the exploit, highlighting Claude's technical approach to addressing the security flaw. The focus is on the methodology used to identify and exploit the vulnerability, providing insights into Claude's capabilities in cybersecurity research.

items.summary: 本文详细介绍了Claude如何针对Firefox中发现的一个漏洞编写利用程序（CVE-2026-2796）。内容深入探讨了漏洞挖掘和利用开发的过程。

items.title: Evaluating and mitigating the growing risk of LLM-discovered 0-days
items.content: AI models can now find high-severity vulnerabilities at scale. This is a moment to empower defenders. We're now using Claude to find and help fix vulnerabilities in open source software.
items.contentSnippet: AI models can now find high-severity vulnerabilities at scale. This is a moment to empower defenders. We're now using Claude to find and help fix vulnerabilities in open source software.

summaries.zh:
文章标题：评估和缓解LLM发现的0-day风险  

AI模型现能大规模发现高危漏洞。这一阶段应加强防御能力。目前正使用Claude检测并协助修复开源软件中的漏洞。
summaries.en: AI models like Claude can identify high-severity vulnerabilities in open-source software at scale. This capability highlights the need to empower defenders. Organizations are leveraging such AI to discover and address these vulnerabilities, enhancing security. The focus is on mitigating risks posed by LLM-discovered 0-days, ensuring open-source software remains resilient.

items.summary:
文章标题：评估和缓解LLM发现的0-day风险  

AI模型现能大规模发现高危漏洞。这一阶段应加强防御能力。目前正使用Claude检测并协助修复开源软件中的漏洞。

items.title: AI models are showing a greater ability to find and exploit vulnerabilities on realistic cyber ranges
items.content: In a recent evaluation of AI models’ cyber capabilities, current Claude models can now succeed at multistage attacks on networks with dozens of hosts using only standard, open-source tools, instead of the custom tools needed by previous generations.
items.contentSnippet: In a recent evaluation of AI models’ cyber capabilities, current Claude models can now succeed at multistage attacks on networks with dozens of hosts using only standard, open-source tools, instead of the custom tools needed by previous generations.

summaries.zh: 近期评估显示，当前AI模型在真实网络环境中的漏洞发现和利用能力显著增强。Claude模型仅需标准开源工具，即可成功实施多阶段网络攻击，而无需依赖以往所需的定制工具。这一进展表明AI在网络安全领域的攻击技术已大幅提升。
summaries.en: AI models, particularly Claude, are demonstrating improved capabilities in cybersecurity by successfully executing multistage attacks on networks with dozens of hosts. Unlike previous generations, these models achieve this using only standard, open-source tools, highlighting a significant advancement in their ability to find and exploit vulnerabilities in realistic cyber ranges. The evaluation underscores their growing potential as both defensive and offensive tools in network security.

items.summary: 近期评估显示，当前AI模型在真实网络环境中的漏洞发现和利用能力显著增强。Claude模型仅需标准开源工具，即可成功实施多阶段网络攻击，而无需依赖以往所需的定制工具。这一进展表明AI在网络安全领域的攻击技术已大幅提升。

items.title: Finding bugs across the Python ecosystem with Claude and property-based testing
items.content: Ensuring that programs are bug-free is one of the most challenging aspects of software engineering. We developed an agent that can efficiently identify bugs in large software projects.
items.contentSnippet: Ensuring that programs are bug-free is one of the most challenging aspects of software engineering. We developed an agent that can efficiently identify bugs in large software projects.

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了使用Claude和属性化测试在Python生态系统中查找错误的方法。确保程序无错误是软件工程中最具挑战性的任务之一。我们开发了一个能够高效识别大型软件项目中错误的代理。
summaries.en: The article discusses developing an agent to identify bugs in large Python projects using Claude and property-based testing. It emphasizes the challenge of ensuring program bug-freedom in software engineering. The agent aims to efficiently detect issues within the Python ecosystem.

items.summary: 本文介绍了使用Claude和属性化测试在Python生态系统中查找错误的方法。确保程序无错误是软件工程中最具挑战性的任务之一。我们开发了一个能够高效识别大型软件项目中错误的代理。

items.title: Experimenting with AI to defend critical infrastructure
items.content: AI could help defenders of critical infrastructure identify the vulnerabilities that attackers might exploit—and close them before they are exploited. Anthropic has partnered with Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) to explore this defensive application of AI, demonstrating both the potential of AI-accelerated defense and the value of public-private partnerships in harnessing AI for national security.
items.contentSnippet: AI could help defenders of critical infrastructure identify the vulnerabilities that attackers might exploit—and close them before they are exploited. Anthropic has partnered with Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) to explore this defensive application of AI, demonstrating both the potential of AI-accelerated defense and the value of public-private partnerships in harnessing AI for national security.

summaries.zh: 人工智能可用于帮助关键基础设施防御者识别并修复攻击者可能利用的漏洞。Anthropic与太平洋西北国家实验室（PNNL）合作探索AI的防御应用，展示了AI加速防御的潜力及公私合作在国家安全领域利用AI的价值。
summaries.en: AI can assist in identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure to prevent attacks. Anthropic has collaborated with Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) to explore this defensive use of AI, showcasing its potential and the importance of public-private partnerships in AI-driven national security.

items.title: Project Vend: Phase two
items.content: In June, we revealed that we’d set up a small shop in our San Francisco office lunchroom, run by an AI shopkeeper. It was part of Project Vend, a free-form experiment exploring how well AIs could do on complex, real-world tasks. How has Claude's business been since we last wrote?
items.contentSnippet: In June, we revealed that we’d set up a small shop in our San Francisco office lunchroom, run by an AI shopkeeper. It was part of Project Vend, a free-form experiment exploring how well AIs could do on complex, real-world tasks. How has Claude's business been since we last wrote?

summaries.zh:
项目“Vend”第二阶段：AI商店表现如何  

6月，我们曾公布在旧金山办公室自助餐厅设立了一家由AI店主经营的小店，这是“Vend”项目的一部分。该项目旨在探索AI在复杂现实任务中的表现。自上次报道以来，Claude的商店运营情况如何？
summaries.en: Project Vend, a San Francisco-based experiment, introduced an AI shopkeeper named Claude in a small office lunchroom shop in June. The initiative explores AI capabilities in real-world tasks. The article inquires about Claude's business performance since the last update.

items.title: AI agents find $4.6M in blockchain smart contract exploits
items.content: We evaluated AI agents' ability to exploit smart contracts using a new benchmark comprising contracts that were actually exploited.
items.contentSnippet: We evaluated AI agents' ability to exploit smart contracts using a new benchmark comprising contracts that were actually exploited.

summaries.zh: AI代理通过评估实际被利用的智能合约，发现460万美元的区块链智能合约漏洞。测试旨在评估AI代理利用智能合约的能力，并使用新的基准方法进行验证。
summaries.en: AI agents successfully identified $4.6 million worth of vulnerabilities in blockchain smart contracts through a benchmark test. The evaluation used real-world exploited contracts to assess the agents' exploit capabilities. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of AI in detecting smart contract flaws.

items.summary: AI代理通过评估实际被利用的智能合约，发现460万美元的区块链智能合约漏洞。测试旨在评估AI代理利用智能合约的能力，并使用新的基准方法进行验证。

items.title: Project Fetch: Can Claude train a robot dog?
items.content: How much does Claude help people program robots? To find out, two teams of Anthropic staff raced to teach quadruped robots to fetch beach balls. The AI-assisted team completed tasks faster and was the only group to make real progress toward full autonomy.
items.contentSnippet: How much does Claude help people program robots? To find out, two teams of Anthropic staff raced to teach quadruped robots to fetch beach balls. The AI-assisted team completed tasks faster and was the only group to make real progress toward full autonomy.

summaries.zh: 《Project Fetch》项目测试了Claude在编程机器人方面的帮助。Anthropic公司两支团队竞速训练四足机器人捡拾沙滩球。AI辅助团队完成任务更快，是唯一取得自主性进展的队伍。
summaries.en: Project Fetch involved two Anthropic staff teams racing to teach quadruped robots to fetch beach balls, using Claude for AI assistance. The AI-assisted team completed tasks faster and was the only group to make progress toward full autonomy. The experiment demonstrated Claude's effectiveness in robot programming.

items.summary: 《Project Fetch》项目测试了Claude在编程机器人方面的帮助。Anthropic公司两支团队竞速训练四足机器人捡拾沙滩球。AI辅助团队完成任务更快，是唯一取得自主性进展的队伍。

items.title: Building AI for cyber defenders
items.content: We invested in improving Claude's ability to help defenders detect, analyze, and remediate vulnerabilities in code and deployed systems. This work allowed Claude Sonnet 4.5 to match or eclipse Opus 4.1 in discovering code vulnerabilities and other cyber skills. Adopting and experimenting with AI will be key for defeners to keep pace.
items.contentSnippet: We invested in improving Claude's ability to help defenders detect, analyze, and remediate vulnerabilities in code and deployed systems. This work allowed Claude Sonnet 4.5 to match or eclipse Opus 4.1 in discovering code vulnerabilities and other cyber skills. Adopting and experimenting with AI will be key for defeners to keep pace.

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了对Claude的改进，以提升其在代码和部署系统中的漏洞检测、分析和修复能力。Claude Sonnet 4.5在发现代码漏洞及其他网络安全技能方面表现优异，可与Opus 4.1匹敌。文章强调，采用和实验AI是防御者保持同步的关键。
summaries.en: The article discusses investments in enhancing Claude's capabilities to assist cyber defenders in detecting, analyzing, and remediating vulnerabilities in code and systems. Claude Sonnet 4.5 has been improved to match or surpass Opus 4.1 in identifying code vulnerabilities and other cyber skills. The article emphasizes that adopting and experimenting with AI is crucial for defenders to stay current in cybersecurity. (100 words)

items.title: LLMs and Biorisk
items.content:
Our work at Anthropic is animated by the potential for AI to advance scientific
                    discovery—especially
                    in biology and medicine. At the same time, AI is fundamentally a dual-use technology. This
                    article
                    explains why we believe that evaluating biorisk and safeguarding against it is a critical
                    element
                    of responsible AI development.
items.contentSnippet:
Our work at Anthropic is animated by the potential for AI to advance scientific
                    discovery—especially
                    in biology and medicine. At the same time, AI is fundamentally a dual-use technology. This
                    article
                    explains why we believe that evaluating biorisk and safeguarding against it is a critical
                    element
                    of responsible AI development.

summaries.zh: Anthropic公司致力于利用AI推动生物和医学领域的科学发现。但AI作为一项具有双重用途的技术，其潜在风险不容忽视。公司认为，评估生物风险并采取防护措施，是负责任AI发展的关键环节。
summaries.en: Anthropic believes AI, particularly large language models (LLMs), can advance biological and medical discovery. However, AI is a dual-use technology, raising concerns about biorisk. The company emphasizes evaluating and safeguarding against biorisk as a key aspect of responsible AI development.
